function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The warning 'Boolean Series key will be reindexed to match DataFrame index' was due to using a boolean mask on a subset of the DataFrame. To prevent index misalignment, the filtering was revised to apply the status and QA conditions directly on the full DataFrame using a single boolean expression: `df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (~qa_mask)]`. This ensures the mask is aligned with the full DataFrame's index and avoids the warning. The resulting `completed_clean` DataFrame is accurate and contains exactly 809 completed orders (815 total completed minus 6 QA)."}
